summary: A prompt is a specification, not a wish. You write numbered rules that can be checked, two few-shot examples (one normal, one not-found) and a rule for the missing answer, count what the longer prompt costs on every call, and learn why the examples must differ from your test questions.
goal: Rewrite a weak prompt into one with numbered rules, two examples and a rule for the missing answer.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: add prompts.py, run show_prompts.py and match the two token counts
Step 2: add a fifth rule, predict the tokens it adds, then check
Step 3: copy a test question into an example and see the leak test fail
Step 4: rewrite a weak ticket-summary prompt with rules and two examples, and count its tokens
Play the Prompt Doctor game to the end and see your score
